2608.20011.title: Manifold Drift in Flow Preference Optimization: A Root Cause of Reward Hacking
2608.20011.paper_summary: Preference optimization is a standard alignment method for generative models, yet extending it to continuous-time dynamics remains non-trivial. In flow matching, reward-driven updates modify transport trajectories without an inherent constraint to the pretrained data manifold and can move terminal samples off the pretrained support. We formalize this failure mode as manifold drift. Theoretically, we show that optimal flow matching recovers the terminal data distribution, whereas a preference update leaves the pretrained manifold whenever its induced terminal displacement has a nonzero normal component. As a remedy, we propose ThermoDPO, a temperature-controlled objective that anchors pairwise preference optimization on preferred samples. Across temperature regimes, this objective connects rejection sampling fine-tuning and FlowDPO and controls a pointwise reconstruction-based surrogate for manifold distance. To counteract diminished signals at low temperatures, we further introduce a weighted variant, ThermoDPO-weighted. On the main toy benchmark, ThermoDPO-weighted attains a StrictScore of 0.899, compared with 0.629 for FlowDPO and 0.857 for FlowDPO+RFT. On SD3.5-M at CFG = 4.5, it improves OCR by 47.5% and the average of four metrics by 16.0%.
2608.20011.paper_summary_zh: 偏好優化是生成模型的一種標準對齊方法，但將其擴展到連續時間動態仍然不是一件簡單的事。<lb/>在流匹配中，基於獎勵的更新會修改傳輸軌跡，而不受預訓練數據流形的內在約束，並且可能會將終端樣本移出預訓練支持。<lb/>我們將這種失效模式形式化為流形漂移。<lb/>從理論上講，我們顯示最佳流匹配能夠恢復終端數據分佈，而偏好更新在其誘導的終端位移具有非零法向量分量時，會使預訓練流形偏離。<lb/>作為補救措施，我們提出了ThermoDPO，一種溫度控制的目標，將成對偏好優化固定在首選樣本上。<lb/>在不同的溫度範圍內，這個目標將拒絕採樣微調和FlowDPO聯繫起來，並控制基於點的重建替代品以衡量流形距離。<lb/>為了抵消低溫下信號的減弱，我們進一步引入了一種加權變體，ThermoDPO-weighted。<lb/>在主要的玩具基準上，ThermoDPO-weighted達到了0.899的StrictScore，而FlowDPO為0.629，FlowDPO+RFT為0.857。<lb/>在SD3.5-M上，CFG = 4.5時，它將OCR提高了47.5%，四個指標的平均值提高了16.0%。
